{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print('Number of unique patient_ids:', df['patient_id'].nunique())
print('Total number of rows:', len(df))
print('Number of duplicate patient_ids:', len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique())

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
print('\nCount of -999 in biomarker_baseline:', (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum())

# Check assay_batch values
print('\nAssay batch distribution:')
df['assay_batch'].value_counts()"}
